description: Client-side script for booking appointments, managing date/time selection, and form submission in the 'book_appointment' webpage.

methods.name: initialise_select_date
methods.description: Initializes the date selection page, sets up global variables, and UI components.

methods.name: get_global_variables
methods.description: Fetches appointment settings and timezone data from server.

methods.name: setup_timezone_selector
methods.description: Populates timezone dropdown with available options and selects local timezone.

methods.name: setup_date_picker
methods.description: Configures date picker with min and max selectable dates based on settings.

methods.name: hide_next_button
methods.description: Disables the 'Next' button and sets its click handler to prompt user to select date/time.

methods.name: show_next_button
methods.description: Enables the 'Next' button and sets its click handler to proceed to details page.

methods.name: on_date_or_timezone_select
methods.description: Handles user selection of date/time, updates available slots.

methods.name: get_time_slots
methods.description: Retrieves available appointment slots for selected date and timezone from server.

methods.name: update_time_slots
methods.description: Displays available time slots or a message if none are available.

methods.name: get_timeslot_div_layout
methods.description: Creates a DOM element for a timeslot with event listener for selection.

methods.name: clear_time_slots
methods.description: Removes all timeslot elements from the container.

methods.name: get_slot_layout
methods.description: Generates HTML for a timeslot display, formatted with moment.js.

methods.name: select_time
methods.description: Handles user clicking on a timeslot, marks it as selected.

methods.name: set_default_timeslot
methods.description: Automatically selects the first available timeslot.

methods.name: navigate_to_page
methods.description: Switches between date/time selection page and details entry page.

methods.name: setup_details_page
methods.description: Prepares the appointment details page with selected date/time and URL params.

methods.name: setup_search_params
methods.description: Pre-fills form fields from URL query parameters and disables them if present.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Validates form, creates appointment via server call, and redirects on success.

methods.name: get_form_data
methods.description: Collects contact info from form fields into an object.
